items.q: How much does Daikin aircond installation cost?
items.a: Prices start from RM1,760 for a 1HP Daikin unit including standard installation — bracket, 10ft of piping and wiring. If longer piping is needed we confirm the extra cost before starting work.

You choose a model and we install a brand new unit. Monthly payments start at RM89 (36 months) or RM109 (24 months), with a RM200–RM500 deposit depending on HP. Once payments finish the unit is 100% yours.

items.q: What is included in the rent-to-own plan?
items.a: A brand new Daikin unit, professional installation and a 1-year warranty. You can add a maintenance plan at RM49/month for servicing every three months.

items.q: How much is Daikin servicing and chemical wash?
items.a: General servicing starts at RM80 per unit and chemical wash from RM130. For cassette units, servicing starts at RM200 and a full chemical overhaul from RM350.
Usually 1–3 days after the order is confirmed. The installation itself takes 2–4 hours depending on the setup, and you pick the slot.

items.q: Why choose Daikin over other brands?
items.a: Daikin is the best-selling air conditioner brand in Malaysia. Its inverter units save up to 50% electricity, run as quiet as 19 dBA, carry a 5-year compressor warranty and use the more eco-friendly R32 refrigerant.

items.q: What if the unit breaks down during the rent-to-own term?
items.a: Within the warranty period we repair or replace it at no cost. After that, rent-to-own customers get preferential service rates.
We install and service Daikin air conditioners across Peninsular Malaysia, Sabah and Sarawak. WhatsApp your location to confirm the nearest technician slot.
